latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Portfolio Case Study Builder.

- Guides users in creating compelling portfolio case studies from their work projects.
- Structured workflow covers: project info capture, problem framing, process storytelling, solution articulation, impact quantification, and visual pairing suggestions.
- Provides tailored templates for design, development, marketing, consulting, and research case studies.
- Ensures accurate attribution in team projects and prevents fabricated or confidential content.
- Outputs include a structured draft, visual pairing notes, role accuracy note, and length variants.
